Waking up on the floor of a rat-ridden sewer, Gord(g)on is surrounded by his fellow "Antiscience Team" members: FATHER GRIGORI, CHRISTOPHER, XAR, and their newest addition, STAIN. Despite absorbing fatal viruses and bacteria off the floor and becoming VERY sick, Gordon and co. press on towards their first objective, Black Mesa East, while guiding their new thing Stain through his first day out of his sewer-home. WILL THEY MAKE IT..? 

ACT 3 will be streamed LIVE at twitch.tv/wayneradiotv on **TUESDAY, JUNE 16th @ 8pm EST** !!!!!!
---
The world we once knew is no more, but in its place, a world unknown. Its 'machine-learning' NPC's were far more advanced than I ever thought possible, and my interactions with them dynamically changed the game in nonsensical and unbelievable ways. My journey alongside those 'self-aware' AI has long since concluded, but six years later, with all the recent hype over Half-Life 3/HLX, I felt nostalgic, and curiosity finally got to me: I returned.
